title: Julia sets on a circle of parameters
hook: As c circles the origin, the Julia set of z² + c shatters into dust and reassembles.
alt: A detailed fractal shape in warm and cool colors with a two-fold symmetry. As a point moves around a circle, the shape tears apart into scattered dust and then joins back into one connected piece.
author: @fatou.dust

presets.label: c = −0.7885, connected
presets.note: c is in the period-2 bulb of the Mandelbrot set, |c + 1| < 1/4, so the critical orbit stays bounded and J_c is connected.

presets.label: c = 0.7885, dust
presets.note: On the real axis past c = 1/4 the critical orbit escapes, so c is outside the Mandelbrot set and J_c is a Cantor set.
